contract.gap: Registered 3D reconstruction alone does not provide the reusable components, finite connections, editable hierarchy, task-specific validation, and inherited state required for long-horizon engineering reconstruction of a heterogeneous industrial site.
contract.task: Analyze B01-B36 as one sequential reconstruction record to determine how a general-purpose reasoning model, executable geometry tools, and persistent external engineering state are combined as reconstruction dependencies accumulate.
outcomes: division of labor between model-side problem formulation and deterministic geometry computation
descriptive broadening of the operator and decision portfolio as dependencies accumulate
cross-batch composition through persistent external state and propagation risk from shared abstractions

questions.text: How does a persistent general-purpose reasoning workflow change as industrial 3D reconstruction progresses from local fitting to reusable equipment, connected representations, and state-constrained site closure?

contract.contribution: A B01-B36 longitudinal field study showing that industrial 3D reconstruction is better described as persistent orchestration of explicit, task-specific geometry operations than as repeated direct 3D generation; the documented operator portfolio broadens with reconstruction dependency, and persistent external state enables composition while making abstraction errors consequential.
nonclaims: not evidence that GPT-6 Astra learns over B01-B36
not a causal estimate of task complexity on reasoning behavior
not a global benchmark success rate
not survey-grade or independently surveyed station accuracy
not evidence of superiority over another model or specialized reconstruction system
not evidence that persistent state improves accuracy relative to a stateless baseline
D37 and later work are outside the main empirical boundary

semantic_locks.canonical: main empirical record is B01-B36 only; D37 and later work do not support the main narrative
C2 operator/decision broadening is the main empirical claim; C3 persistent state is the systems claim; C1 model/tool division is foundational attribution

observable model/harness contribution is evidence selection, representation/decomposition, program authoring/revision, and interpretation of external feedback; numerical fitting and validation are executed by deterministic tools
B01-B36 shows a descriptive broadening of task-specific operators; it does not establish model learning, a universal complexity law, or a causal complexity-to-reasoning relationship
persistent external engineering state is the documented mechanism for cross-batch reuse/composition and a propagation surface for shared abstraction errors; no stateless ablation exists

coarse-reference residuals are task-local comparisons to registered photogrammetric geometry and are not independent survey accuracy; connected systems additionally require endpoint/contact/continuity checks
some decisions depend on human authorization or review, including B08 equivalence and late omission review; the workflow is agent-driven and human-steerable

terminology.preferred: longitudinal single-site field study / sequential reconstruction record
registered photogrammetric reference / registered coarse geometry
operator/decision portfolio broadens as reconstruction dependencies accumulate
task-local residual / endpoint consistency / coverage diagnostic / state-preservation check

alignment.method: Persistent evidence-program-validation workflow with explicit deterministic geometry tools and inherited Blender/Python state.
alignment.evidence: B01-B36 preserved continuation notes, plans, diagnostics, validation JSON, process artifacts, and selected operator-prevalence summaries.
alignment.result: Local fitting remains present while reusable-scope, connectivity/path, coverage/review, and interference/state-preservation operations appear as reconstruction dependencies accumulate; later batches explicitly consume earlier masters and endpoints.
alignment.interpretation: The general model is best described as an orchestration/problem-formulation layer around explicit geometry operators; persistent external state enables compositional reconstruction and propagates shared abstraction errors.
alignment.limitation: Single historical site sequence; no matched planner/model, stateless ablation, complete independent survey reference, or controlled complexity manipulation.
alignment.contribution: Evidence-grounded longitudinal account of how an agentic industrial 3D reconstruction workflow broadens its operator portfolio and composes through persistent state.
